note: The screenshot and GIF set for outreach posts (#570). Edit this file, then run `node scripts/outreach-media.mjs` (needs sharp 0.34 or newer for the GIFs: `npm i --no-save sharp@0.34.5`). It writes public/outreach/ and its index. Pictures come from public/docs-images, named by their path under it, and take their caption from content/gallery.json when the picture is listed there.

slideshows.title: A walk through town
slideshows.caption: Five captures from the test town, one after another: the spawn square, the store, the fuel station, the bank and the car lot. A slideshow of stills, not footage.

slideshows.title: Police and hospital
slideshows.caption: The police post, the hospital, its front and ambulance bay, and a payphone. A slideshow of stills, not footage.

slideshows.title: The underworld
slideshows.caption: The lock-up row, the fence's yard, the chop shop, money sacks from the cash van and the moonshine still. A slideshow of stills, not footage.

slideshows.title: The edge of town
slideshows.caption: The hideout bench, the farm, the quarry barrier and the moonshine still. A slideshow of stills, not footage.

clipsToCapture.shows: A player dials Report a crime at a payphone; an officer on duty hears it on the radio and the dispatch board lists it.
A player is shot and goes down, a medic clocks in at the hospital desk and revives them.
A player drills the cash van's box at the bank doorstep and money sacks appear.
Pick a lock-up door, hotwire the car, drive it into the chop shop yard and watch the payout.
An officer arrests a robber at the fuel till and the robber ends up in the cell.
A new player fills in form R-89 and the clerk hands over an ID card on the square.
